instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. United bears fuel risk for United Express flights; Delta bears fuel risk for Delta Connection RJ flights. Some pro-rate EMB120/Continental routes where SKYW bears fuel risk. No hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Estimated: fuel expense $149,429K / $1.12 per gallon = ~133.4M gallons. Item 7: 'average price of fuel increasing 15.5% per gallon, to $1.12 during 2003 from $0.97 during 2002.'
